Messages.Author: Madman2001
Messages.Body:
Folks:

I am confused about the effects of S:Dodge and S:CE on "all combatant"
types of damage.

For example, my minion strikes with Burst of Sunlight. My opponent
uses Majesty. Does my minion take any damage?

My minion strikes with Burst of Sunlight. The opposing minion uses
Strike:Dodge. Does my minion take damage?

My blocking minion uses Weather Control. Will a Majesty (or any other
card?) keep any of the minions or retainers in combat from taking
damage?

My minion strikes with a Grenade at close range. The opposing minion
uses Strike: Dodge. Does my minion take damage?

My acting minion strikes with a Bomb. The opposing minion uses S:CE.
Does my minion take 5 damage?

Thanks in advance,
Madman

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
"Madman2001" <Mad...@madman.com> wrote:
> I am confused about the effects of S:Dodge and S:CE on "all combatant"
> types of damage.

The "all combatant" doesn't change the effect of S:CE or S:Dodge.

> For example, my minion strikes with Burst of Sunlight. My opponent
> uses Majesty. Does my minion take any damage?

No. S:CE "ends combat before other strikes can be resolved or any
<strike-resolution-based> damage dealt" [6.4.5]

> My minion strikes with Burst of Sunlight. The opposing minion uses
> Strike:Dodge. Does my minion take damage?

Yes. Dodge just "protects the dodging minion and his possessions
from the effects of the opposing strike" [6.4.5], it doesn't protect
the other minion.

> My blocking minion uses Weather Control. Will a Majesty (or any other
> card?) keep any of the minions or retainers in combat from taking
> damage?

No. (Card text/rules timing)

> My minion strikes with a Grenade at close range. The opposing minion
> uses Strike: Dodge. Does my minion take damage?

Yes. [6.4.5]

> My acting minion strikes with a Bomb. The opposing minion uses S:CE.
> Does my minion take 5 damage?

No. [6.4.5]
